changes.old: Read established hidden facts within the stated scope; missing facts are not invented. Existing information defenses control their actual protected fields, identities, areas and generating school/rank. Partial readable information remains useful; a protected or genuinely undefined answer is non-actionable and does not diagnose why it is unavailable. changes.replacement:
KEEP source-authorized hidden but established world facts as readable information. An authoritative Director-established fact does not need a pre-existing software log or a caster-known document; conversely, a source file, nonempty story label or fixture is not proof of an actual campaign fact. The spell's scope authorizes disclosure, not invention of an otherwise undefined history, actor, faction or operation. Missing data is not zero, Neutral, nonmembership, absence of a trap or proof of an empty past. Preserve exact fact source, version, time precision and audience separately from the current query.

Read every unprotected fact the individual spell promises; do not reduce all activities/history to one favored record or an arbitrary sample. A specific protection applies only to the information, subject, generating school/rank and time scope it actually covers. Protection of one person does not conceal independent institutional/environmental facts, and protected personal facts cannot be relabeled institution/effect history to evade the protection. Supply independently meaningful readable fields. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden reason, number of withheld records or protection. If existence itself is protected, disclose no placeholder, ID gap, total or count derived from that protected existence. Claim No qualifying fact only where absence itself is established and readable; otherwise do not certify completeness beyond the readable facts. An explicitly permitted masking effect retains its own false/altered-result rule; do not override it with a generic truthful-result assertion.

Equivalent paid inquiries under materially unchanged facts, authority and applicable protections give consistent overlapping information across casters/rephrasing. Genuine new events, changed protections or new established evidence can change later paid answers. Knowledge itself supplies no skill success, disarm, control, consent, authority, spell acquisition or free communication. KEEP the reviewed observer-specific location rule: a revealed actual location ends Hidden for that observer and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers for that observer; it does not end Invisible or grant sight. Independent darkness, blindness, smoke and other actual modifiers remain. Communicated information requires a real channel and grants only what was actually communicated. Public teaching/procedure projection never publishes the internal fact/protection/donor dossiers or private membership merely because the rule can query them.

changes.old:
KEEP one instantaneous revelation in a60ft cone originating at the caster. NEW use the ordinary cone geometry and line of effect from that origin; choose direction at commitment. Every readable portion is examined once, without a creature-count cap. The caster alone receives the following snapshot; communicating it uses ordinary channels. Revelation neither paints targets for allies nor removes an actual concealment, wall or information defense.

Hidden traps: reveal the current physical site, occupied footprint, armed/dormant state and immediate trigger category of every actual trap in the readable cone. A mundane concealed plate qualifies; a dangerous creature is not automatically a trap. This reveals no automatic disarm solution, secret combination or future die outcome. Enemies: reveal the current occupied footprint and creature count of actual beings presently intending or executing a meaningful hostile act against the caster or a member of the caster's current party. This explicitly NEW intent predicate is not alignment, reputation, species or mere disagreement. It does not read the plan, memories, exact identity or statistics. Actual protection of intent/location can independently limit those fields. An unprotected invisible enemy's location can be learned without becoming visibly targetable for a sight-required spell; ordinary attack concealment remains.

Magic: reveal each actual current magical effect's local footprint, spell/nonspell category, generating school/rank when its source has those fields, and whether it is active or suppressed. An absent school is not Universal; a dormant enchanted item's relevant magic is distinguishable from an active spell but supplies no charges, attunement history or full property list. Overlapping sources remain distinct, not an invented combined spell. Lies: NEW consider factual assertions actually communicated by a creature currently in the cone during the preceding six elapsed seconds. For assertions the caster perceived and understood, identify whether the speaker knowingly asserted what they believed false. A sincere error is not a deliberate lie; uncertainty, irony and an assertion whose meaningful content was not understood yield no invented objective truth. A scripted sound without a current asserting mind supplies no fabricated belief. This is a bounded deception reading, not continuous honesty enforcement or a substitute correct answer.

No generic save is added to these information outputs. Any actual source defense prescribing a check or opposed procedure keeps that procedure and its real rank/ability requirements. No fact is extracted through a blocked field by repeated rewording; unchanged inquiries use the shared stable-information rule. The effect disarms nothing, ends no invisibility or spell, damages nothing and compels no confession. It leaves a remembered snapshot, with no tracking after the instant or promise that an enemy, trap or magical footprint remains where it was.
changes.replacement:

The origin cell itself is excluded; a source may choose a forward origin on its own actual space boundary. This is a NEW DI7 template choice, not recovered ordinary cone text. Existing range metric, total-cover, actual vertical placement and no-corner-cutting constraints still apply; this template gives no generic new geometry to other spells.

Hidden traps: reveal the current physical site, occupied footprint, armed/dormant state and immediate trigger category of every actual readable trap. CORRECTION to the proposal's blanket retained-concealment language: learning a location ends Hidden for this caster and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers against this informed observer, as already reviewed; it does not make an Invisible creature visible or satisfy a sight-required spell. Independent concealment still applies. The record is a snapshot, not a tracking feed. No ally receives the knowledge or observer-state change without actually obtaining that information through a legal channel.

changes.old:
KEEP one willing perceived ally, including self, within120ft and line of effect, and exactly two protected attacks or spells. NEW resolve the Instantaneous source into a nonconcentration ward lasting at most one elapsed minute, with two charges and no recipient Reaction. One operative Premonition Shield family per recipient: a successful fresh cast replaces the prior ward, discarding unused old charges rather than adding them. Creation is not itself one of the recipient's protected subsequent spell events.

NEW event definition: each separate direct attack against the recipient is one event. A spell's immediate resolution that directly targets the recipient or actually includes its space in the resolved area is one event for that recipient, grouping that cast's simultaneous components/beams/attacks in that same immediate resolution. Thus a three-attack mundane Multiattack supplies three events, while a single multi-beam spell's immediate resolution supplies one; do not count both the spell and its constituent attacks. A later periodic spell occurrence is a fresh event at that occurrence, not unlimited protection from the entire spell identity. Resolve simultaneous event order under the ordinary stable source order.

Consume one charge before the qualifying attack roll or the spell's recipient resolution, even on a miss, successful save, zero damage or a nondamaging beneficial spell. An attack cancelled before it is made, a countered spell that never resolves, an area not actually including the recipient, or a dormant effect with no occurrence does not consume a charge. This explicit next-event rule prevents saving the ward for a favorable damage result. Suppression makes the ward unavailable without consuming charges for events during the gap; resumption retains only its original remaining charges and deadline.

For the covered event, prevent all eligible direct damage assigned to this recipient, never below zero, at the actual finite-prevention stage after recipient defenses and before post-defense sharing/tempHP. Pre-mitigation sharing such as Bloodbond/Veinlock has already assigned separate recipient shares; this ward covers only its recipient's own share. A post-defense transfer flagged to skip recipient prevention cannot be prevented again and does not become a new attack/spell event merely because it retains provenance. No prevented damage is transferred, stored, reflected or converted into healing. All actual would-die, concentration and Wound consequences then use the real remaining damage under ordinary rules.

The spell prevents damage only. A hit remains a hit; conditions, movement, lost concentration from a separate rule, item effects, direct HP assignments/sacrifices and death-state effects are not automatically prevented. Falling, mundane hazards and nonattack nonspell effects do not become eligible by association with a spell. On the second qualifying event finish its one protected resolution, then end the ward. Expiry, dispel or recipient destruction discards unused charges. Neither rest, transfer of a token nor another scene refreshes this application.
changes.replacement:
KEEP self or one ally and exactly two subsequent qualifying attack/spell occurrences. NEW require a willing perceived allied creature, including self, within 120 feet and line of effect; replace the operational Instantaneous shorthand with an attached, nonconcentration ward lasting 60 elapsed seconds from resolution, with two uses and no recipient Reaction. Its existence does not require the caster to remain nearby or conscious after establishment. One operative same-spell family per recipient across casters: a successful new ward replaces the old and discards its remainder. Establishment of this ward is not itself a use-consuming occurrence. A failed/countered new cast does not itself replace an older ward. Rest and token/owner/scene changes replenish nothing.

NEW event identity: one nonspell attack is one occurrence, irrespective of its separate damage types/riders. Distinct Multiattack attacks are distinct occurrences. One spell's immediate resolution is one occurrence per recipient, grouping all that cast's immediate beams/missiles/attacks even when rolled sequentially. Do not count the same spell and its constituent attacks twice. A later real source-scheduled tick, paid maintenance pulse, delayed occurrence or entry occurrence is a separate event, keyed to its actual occurrence ID, not another cast. Mere passive ongoing presence, a stat query or a renamed packet is no occurrence. A spell-associated weapon damage rider in its parent hit is not a second event unless its own source genuinely creates a separate resolution. Distinct actually cast spells inside a composite Action remain distinct casts/occurrences.

Uses are automatic, not optional damage shields. An actual miss, successful save, zero-damage hit or resolving nondamaging beneficial spell still consumes a use. CORRECTION to the proposed universally pre-roll timing: resolve any legal target-substitution window at its existing source timing; automatically commit the use on the attack's actual final recipient before hit/miss consequences and damage, even if the unchanged attack die has already been rolled. There is no post-result choice to save the use. For a spell, commit before that recipient's first actual resolution component. A canceled attack never made, a spell countered before effect resolution, a guessed empty space with no actual recipient, or an area portion excluded by total cover consumes none. Do not charge the abandoned intended target after a genuine retarget.

At the finite-prevention stage, after that recipient's defenses and before post-defense sharing/temp HP, prevent all otherwise eligible damage from the covered occurrence to that recipient. Retain distinct underlying damage roots/rolls; grouping protection does not merge damage packets or create extra Wound/trigger events. Bloodbond/Veinlock pre-mitigation splits first assign the real raw shares. NEW explicit admission for this interface: a positive pre-mitigation share may consume/claim a ward use for its actual recipient against that parent occurrence, without making that recipient hit or transferring nondamage riders; group by original attack/spell occurrence and ward recipient, so that occurrence cannot charge the same ward twice. A zero share creates no share-only occurrence. Each such recipient still has only its own one defense/prevention stage. Post-defense transferred branches explicitly skipping prevention neither consume a new ward use nor receive this prevention, regardless of retained spell/attack provenance. Direct HP payment, HP assignment, environmental falling and nonattack nonspell harm are not eligible by association.

A hit is still a hit; independently applicable control, movement, Maiming, nondamage riders, item damage, lethal assignments and source-specific concentration ending remain. Positive-damage-dependent riders recheck actual remaining damage. Prevention produces no transfer, reflection, stored damage, healing or restored payment. Covered components of the second occurrence remain authorized until that one occurrence finishes, then the depleted ward ends; an unrelated interleaved event gains nothing. Recheck actual ward existence/suppression for each still-unresolved component: a genuine dispel/expiry can stop later components but never undo already prevented damage. Suppression prevents new use commitments during the gap and prevents applying the ward while suppressed; it does not refund a previously committed occurrence use or extend the deadline. On return only the same still-live record and its actual remaining/committed occurrence may continue. Recipient death/destruction, removal or expiry ends it; prior caster death alone does not. The half-open duration excludes new occurrences at the exact deadline.

A later periodic occurrence of the same spell spends the second charge. A post-defense damage transfer that forbids another prevention step is not secretly blocked by this ward.
replacement: DI7-03-A: A successful ward at0 has two uses and deadline60. A final-target sword miss at5 automatically consumes use1 before consequences. After that occurrence finishes the ward ends; a third attack is unprotected. A zero-damage or resolving beneficial nondamaging spell could have consumed either use instead.

DI7-03-B: A single immediate spell cast has three separately rolled beams against the warded recipient. One occurrence use covers their eligible damage without merging the three roots. An actual later tick is another occurrence and uses the second. A separately transferred post-defense6 flagged skipPrevention receives no new ward prevention or use; a real positive pre-mitigation share instead has its own recipient defense stage and may qualify once against that parent occurrence.

changes.old:
KEEP copying one nondamaging spell cast in the last three rounds. NEW select one actual completed original spell-cast event that the caster directly perceived and identified when it occurred, no earlier than eighteen elapsed seconds before commitment; exactly eighteen seconds qualifies. Its original caster must have been within120ft and line of effect at that observed cast. Remembered event provenance, not the original caster's current presence or location, supplies the historical anchor. An item, nonspell technique, false image, countered attempt or merely reported event is not an eligible original cast.

NEW finite admission: the exact original spell mode must have a complete authorized operational procedure, generating rank0–7, and normal casting time of one Action or Bonus Action. The copied identity need not be on the echoer's ordinary class list: Fate Echo provides temporary access solely for this paid copy. It creates no class level, permanent knowledge, repertoire slot or later casting permission. Keep the original generating school, rank and version; do not union placements or choose a cheaper school. A source specifically prohibiting copying remains prohibited.

Nondamaging is a procedure-level restriction, not a lucky outcome. Reject a mode with any printed immediate, delayed, periodic or conditional damage, direct HP loss, lethal state assignment, damaging body/summon, damaging trap, damage rider or granted damaging attack. A damaging spell that missed is still damaging. A genuinely separate complete nondamaging mode can qualify on its own. Healing, protection, information and nondamaging control may qualify within their actual protections; ordinary consequences of later independent choices are not automatically the copied spell's damage. Copy/release/echo/contingency or further spell-access mechanisms are excluded, as are any events already descended from a copy, to prevent recursive permission and provenance loops. These are expressly NEW admission limits requiring agreement.

NEW one composite Action: commit Fate Echo's own final price/components/cast hooks first. On its successful resolution, immediately perform the selected copy within that Action, paying its ordinary rank-based price under the echoer's actual legal modifiers plus all independent RP, consumed materials, focus/tool and source costs. Validate ability to pay the full composite before commitment; reserved payment cannot be spent by another concurrent declaration. The copy is a new spell-cast event with its own real casting components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transition, cast triggers and Counterspell opportunity. No second Action is charged, but no independent next Action or second copy is granted. The echoer uses the same actual casting ability route that cast Fate Echo, their own PB and stats; no donor die, attack bonus, saves or prior outcome is replayed. Original rank scaling uses the fixed copied rank; printed caster-level scaling uses the echoer's actual granting class level, an explicit NEW choice.

Choose fresh legal targets/area and ordinary permitted modes within that exact copied procedure. Origin is the echoer and range is the copied spell's own range, not an added120ft. Original consent, body, environment, command, paid-information, material and source-specific use restrictions still apply. An expired or consumed original object/effect is not restored; a new legal creation pays its full real inputs and obeys its own capacity/economics. The same copied procedure shares the echoer's existing identity-based restrictions and cannot reset their spent source entitlement. Countering Fate Echo prevents the nested cast; countering the nested cast retains both actual payments and does not retry. New lasting effects belong to the echoer with original event provenance retained and their own fresh lawful deadlines. Cast Echo remains a different source with its own still-unadopted procedure.
changes.replacement:
KEEP one non-damaging historic spell copy, Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP and the source three-round window. NEW select exactly one actual original spell-cast event that the echoer directly perceived and identified when cast, with original casting completed no more than 18 elapsed seconds before Fate Echo commitment, inclusive at 18. Record its original caster, event/cast ID, exact source version, original generating class/mode/school/rank, completed-casting timestamp and real observation/line-of-effect receipt within 120 feet then. The original caster need not still be present. The event must already have survived interruption and successfully reached its own effect resolution; no countered attempt, rumor, item activation, nonspell technique, false image or merely recognized later residue qualifies. For a readied original, preparation is its casting timestamp; later release supplies neither a fresher cast nor a second cast. A still-unresolved held original is ineligible.

NEW finite mode gate: its complete authorized operative mode has actual rank 0 through 7 and normal casting time one Action or Bonus Action. A null rank is not 0; a Reaction or longer-casting mode is not admitted. Use the exact observed mode, generating school/rank and source version, not a donor's lower alternative placement or a fabricated nondamaging subset. Original optional metamagic, item modifications, borrowed casting resources or donor stats are not copied as free benefits. A genuinely distinct complete nondamaging mode may qualify, but a damaging mode that missed does not. Reject any mode that itself supplies immediate, delayed, periodic or conditional damage, direct HP loss, lethal assignment, a damaging body/summon/trap, damage rider or granted damaging attack. Later independent voluntary acts do not automatically make ordinary protection/information/healing/control damaging. Reject copying/echo/release/contingency/further-casting-access mechanisms and every copy-descended event, including Fate Echo itself. Actual no-copy restrictions and independently required grants remain.

NEW temporary copied-spell route: Fate Echo waives only the ordinary learned/prepared/class-list permission for this single admitted payload. It does not acquire a class feature, feat charge, artifact permission, source-specific stock, independent per-rest entitlement, permanent repertoire or new pool. The echoer must satisfy all nonwaived payload predicates, actual independent uses/costs, targets/consent, equipment, body, environment and other required source engines. An intrinsic identity-wide limited-use ledger remains the same ledger across real routes; this permission never resets a spent allowance. Where the copied source itself supplies a universal per-user limit, first actual use records that source's normal first-use allowance, not a second acquired class/feat grant. Where a separate acquired engine grants a charge, that charge must actually exist. If an indispensable operand/credential has no actual source or explicit adapter below, that particular payload is inadmissible, not partly invented or silently stripped. Cast Echo, Mirrorsage Echo Release and feat copies keep their own separate unadopted/reviewed scopes.

NEW two-stage paid composite: at declaration fix the copied event/mode and fresh legal target choices (Ready exception below), validate the complete forecast transaction in chronological order, and exclusively reserve its real nested RP/material/use obligations. Quote outer Fate Echo from the current state, then simulate its exact mandatory strain/history and known mandatory beginning changes to determine whether the child could legally start and pay. Do not quote both from the same old Dissonance. If a known inevitable outer transition would block or make the child unaffordable, reject the composite before spending. Reservation is not payment and cannot be spent by a competing declaration. Commit only the outer Action, its actual price/components, concentration transition and ordinary cast-start history/hooks; then open its normal Counterspell window. If it is negated, no child begins: release only unspent child reservations, keep every actual outer payment/history, and create no child cast/strain/concentration change.

On successful outer resolution, immediately revalidate the child against the actual intervening state, including any genuine Reaction cast, current legal targets/materials, resource availability, strain block and selected original mode. Reprice from that actual state. A higher actual child quote requires real unreserved funds as well; insufficient funds or another now-failed predicate ends the copy opportunity with outer costs kept and no child commitment. Do not reserve fictitious discounts or automatically replace a target/source. If valid, commit the child's own full actual price, components, consumed materials, independent uses, concentration and strain/history once, then open a separate normal Counterspell window for that child. No second Action or Bonus Action is charged: this is an explicit one-Action/two-cast exception, not an extra full Action grant. Countering the child retains both actual payments and child history. Resuming either parent never rewrites a later intervening cast's Refrain/history. No recursive cast or ungranted Action follows.

NEW precise child adapter: the child has its observed generating school/rank and uses the actual Fate Echo provider's casting ability, the echoer's current ordinary PB, its own spell attack PB+ability/DC8+PB+ability and its own body/stats. Intrinsic explicit caster-class-level scaling substitutes the real Fate Echo-granting class level, not total level or the donor's level. It is a fate-echo-copy route, not a prepared/always-prepared Wizard matrix, ordinary learned Shaman spell, Mirrorsage Echo Release, feat charge or donor class card acquisition. Price begins with the ordinary rank table plus every actual independent source cost and applicable universal modifier; a class card's expressly replacement printed spell price is its replacement base, not that base plus the rank table. No donor price waiver or free class/feat charge is inherited. Use common spell Dissonance 0/1/2 by actual rank and normal chronological Refrain, actual Limit and legal casting blocks. Prepared-matrix first-distinct exemptions/Matrix modifications, a Shaman ordinary-spell-only totem vent and Mirrorsage release exemptions do not apply merely from the payer's class or a matching name. A genuinely broader existing modifier/paid concentration exception may apply only by its real predicate. Preserve negative restrictions as well as qualifying modifiers.

KEEP the generic no-duplicate-copy-proc guard, correcting the proposal's unrestricted child cast-trigger phrase. Mandatory cast legality, costs, components, strain/history, concentration and counter windows still occur. The child grants its intrinsic lawful spell result and ordinary consequences, but generates no additional class/feat cast-proc, resource-refund, action-grant or copy chain merely because it is a second paid cast. The outer Fate Echo retains its own ordinary permitted hooks. This does not strip an otherwise legal intrinsic finite payload result; no resource loop or independent use reset is permitted. Starting a concentration child ends incompatible prior concentration at child commitment, not outer declaration, unless an actual paid linked-effect source expressly applies. If the child is later countered, displaced concentration is not restored. The child's F uses the echoer's actual permitted casting focus; an explicitly special/consumed material still requires that actual item. All child V/S and other components are performed at its own commitment, not supplied retroactively by the outer cast.

Targets originate at the echoer and use the copied mode's own range/line/effect/consent rules, not an extra 120 feet. Fresh outcomes use actual rolls and current defenses, never the donor's result. Result ownership is the echoer's, with original/copy lineage, independent cast/application IDs, fixed generating rank and actual new effect deadlines retained.
